observed_test_anomalies.root_cause: Not reproduced or identified; no claim of a fixed scheduler/library bug.
observed_test_anomalies.diagnostics: Wheel validation enables faulthandler at 30 seconds, a 300-second test process timeout, and CI jobs have a 15-minute timeout.
